verdict.rationale: Zapier's own Zap workflows and agents are documented as automations that connect apps and perform tasks. Community reports corroborate that trigger-based Zaps (IF/THEN) execute unattended, for example a calendar-sync Zap firing on a Sunday morning without user involvement. However, the pack has no first-party documentation that explicitly describes background or autonomous execution, scheduling, or always-on agent operation. missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing background/autonomous trigger-based execution, documented recurring schedules, evidence that agents run unattended rather than on prompt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
